I'm lonely and wanna play games with people I've tried multiplayer games and MMOs and stuff a lot before and, even if the game itself is fun for me, I usually give up on them because I have trouble finding people to play with and talk to. Is there a reason it'd go differently with this game or this community for it?
Would you recommend the game to others?

Right now the game is still in alpha, as such it is very much still in development. VoIP is not yet integrated, so meeting new people in-game is difficult. You can see them, you can play with them, but talking to them is limited to the local chat (meaning your universe instance, which is like 24 players max). I do imagine that once there is VoIP integration meeting people to play with will be much easier. There is constantly requests for "crewmates" even now in the baby PU via the chat. Once the voice chat comes online I doubt that the requests will go down at all.

There is the ability to join large "Orgs" (organizations) that have scheduled playtimes and discussions. You could take a look at Those Guys With Ships maybe; they seem to have one of the largest active groups that I have seen.

TLDR: The lack of in-game voice support at the moment makes meeting new players more difficult at the moment.
